basic_info.description: Meticulously redesigned gem in the vibrant Excelsior. This Pano-View home offers a harmonious blend of modern style, comfort, and functionality-all thoughtfully curated to deliver a welcoming, move-in ready experience. Tailored for today's lifestyle, the flexible floorplan features an open-concept kitchen complete with center island, quartz countertops, sleek cabinetry, premium appliances, and a walk-in pantry. Next to the kitchen is a cozy living room with an adjacent sunroom, providing a glimpse of the city. Step outside to discover a lovely backyard oasis with its grassy lawn, mature trees, and a wooden deck, perfect for outdoor entertaining or quiet enjoyment. The sun-drenched upper level features an airy family room with wet bar, primary master suite, secondary bedroom, and a guest suite. The master suite is a true sanctuary, complete with a private balcony offering sweeping views of the city, a perfect spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Overlooking Twin Peaks and the surrounding city skyline, the attached family room, epitomizes peace and tranquility. A 2-car side by side garage, an enviable luxury, completes this home. With close proximity to BART, Muni, parks and playgrounds, Safeway, local eateries and shops, 714 London is a Walker's Paradise(95 walk score).
